The '''Kailor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kailor V]].<ref name="TEA" />
